name: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards
benefit:
1. Each Awardee will be presented with a certificate and a cash prize of ₹50,000/-.
   1. The recipient may be considered by the Council for a research grant of ₹50 lakhs after due consideration of the research project with the help of an expert committee.
   1. The Awardee, within 3 years of the receipt of the award, will be considered for a visit abroad to present the research work at a conferen
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a Ph.D. holder with 3 years Post-Doctoral experience.
   1. The applicant should have working experience in any R&amp;D/Academic institution in Kerala continuously for the last 3 years.
   1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 37 years as on 31st December in the notifying year.
